body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


What January viewing, shopping, and New Year’s resolutions suggest for your next Q5 campaign.


1. 1


January still draws a TV crowd. Total TV usage hit a 12-month high in January 2026, and streaming accounted for 47% of viewing.


2. 2


Post-holiday shoppers follow through. MNTN-attributed conversions rose 12% in the week after Christmas compared with the week before.


3. 3


Resolution season reaches beyond the gym. Q5 site traffic grew in 15 of 26 industries in MNTN’s analysis, including hotels and resorts, home improvement, and real estate.


4. 4


Budgets are top of mind. More than half of Americans making 2026 resolutions set a financial goal, yet January card spending grew 2.6% year over year.


5. 5


Make the next step feel doable. Use your ad creative to show how your product can help someone build a small habit, make progress on a goal, or get more for their money.
